excerpt.en: EXCLUSIVE: Comedian Ruby Karp has announced that her new special, I Don’t Trust Adults, will begin streaming on Veeps at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET on Thursday, September 10. Performed Off-Broadway at SoHo Playhouse over the course of six weeks, Karp’s I Don’t Trust Adults tells the story of six different adults who caused the self-described “failed child star” […]
excerpt.fa: اختصاصی: کمدین روبی کارپ اعلام کرده است که ویژه جدید او، به بزرگسالان اعتماد ندارم، از ساعت 5 بعد از ظهر در Veeps پخش خواهد شد.
